no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original SUTENT (sunitinib) NDA 21938 approval (2006). The Medical Review states in section 8.5 that the application was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting, and the Administrative Correspondence checklist records the Advisory Committee Meeting date as N/A. Because no AdComm met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
